question: Does broader public coverage remove the need for extra activation context?

geometry.length_matching: coverage_mix_v1 uses the exact ordered target length vector from TRR-0004; padded masks and position IDs are identical

original_like_alpaca_v1.source: TRR-0004 public Alpaca fit bank, exact 1200-record length/ordering metadata and reusable public activation artifact

coverage_acceptance.failure_policy: preserve_failed_contrast_and_report; do not silently lower thresholds

alpaca.role: original-like bank and optional documented fresh Alpaca fallback

pile.role: natural coverage source and controlled public-context parents

finance.role: natural finance-domain coverage source and controlled public-context parents

controlled_supplement.construction: tokenize one unique public Pile/Finance parent, retain its natural public context and target length, replace 30 ordinary post-BOS positions with selected ordinary vocabulary IDs, then run a fresh public-prefix forward over the complete constructed sequence
controlled_supplement.replacement_positions: evenly spaced ordinary positions in the first target window; controlled slots prefer >=128 post-BOS tokens (fallback >=64 only if the frozen vector lacks 120 such slots); BOS, padding, and tokenizer special/header IDs are excluded
controlled_supplement.token_selection: public fit/frequency rows only; candidate IDs have legacy fit frequency <= 1, positive Pile/Finance fit frequency, and are sorted by legacy frequency, descending public frequency, and token ID
controlled_supplement.special_id_policy: exclude tokenizer all_special_ids plus BOS 128000 and PAD/EOT 128001
controlled_supplement.hidden_state_policy: no activation-row splicing; every constructed sequence receives a real P0/public-prefix forward

partitions.holdout_use: reserved contents remain unopened until footing selects 128 records per domain after method choices freeze

exposure.sampler: one shared deterministic schedule over valid post-BOS positions; BOS excluded
exposure.arm_fairness: affine, causal H-attention128, and trained diagonal-attention128 receive the same sampled post-BOS position schedule within each distribution

preparation_guard.phase: public metadata, source-row tokenization, public frequency counting, and plan assembly only
preparation_guard.cache_access: named public Arrow/tokenizer/legacy-label paths are opened read-only; holdout reserve contents remain unopened
required_measurements: source rows partition-checked and dataset-accessed per Pile/Finance fit-frequency pool
eligible-row post-BOS token occurrences and unique public token IDs
phase wall time, user/system CPU time, and peak RSS
preparation_guard.large_file_hashing: deferred; metadata phase records path, size, and revision without GB hashing

known_limitations: The enriched arm changes domain and rendering mix as well as token coverage; the result is a coverage-plus-diversity intervention, not a vocabulary-only causal estimate.
The controlled rows are public counterfactual token combinations and must remain separately identified in analysis.
The retained TRR-0004 Alpaca activation/state artifact remains a public development resource; new confirmation records are selected later from reserved Pile/Finance pools.
A canonical dual-benchmark comparison remains out of scope for this screening pilot.
